additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0420337-DC/NA/DE-[NA] Out of Service CRM:02679000144
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0420337 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to
one or more following reason (s):
We have checked the charger on SCB and charger is having 2 errors right now.
1. d-plc: TransducerDC4_TF204 > Life sign fault
possible solutions:
check if transducer power supply 24V is ok
check by replacing the voltage transducer
2. PowerConverter[14] > CanComm loss
(for DC3 Converter)
possible solutions:
check converter can wirings.
swap the converter with the next working one (from same group), and check if the error comes on same converter or with the swapped working one.
if error appears on same faulty converter, then the converter is faulty, proceed with the converter replacement.
if error appears on the other working converter, then issue is with the CAN wirings, trace back the CAN wiring connections.
Please carry following spare parts in case replacements are required:
Voltage Transducer 1500VDC / 10VDC > 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW > 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
